plan.title: SRC-PAR-001 — Single-stage RFQ invites mapped vendors

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen.
Enable eRFX project creation for this case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation.
Set the single-stage event type to RFQ.
Apply the first available RFQ pricing template.
Add the specified product and quantity.
Complete the pricing sheet required before scheduling and publishing.
Set the requested delivery location for the product row.
Verify the selected delivery location was retained.
Invite every vendor mapped to the selected product, as requested by the scenario.
Verify the mapped-vendor invitation strip is no longer shown.
Verify publishing reached a real project page.
Open the published stage's Participants list.
Verify that invited participants are present on the published stage.
